title: basemap
description: One `stride basemap` run: the map view's roads and water fetched from OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API, for every 0.1-degree block a stored GPS route passes through and every block next to one, that no earlier run fetched. A busy server stops the run with the blocks already fetched kept; run it again to fetch the rest.

blocks_fetched.description: blocks this run fetched and stored

blocks_pending.description: blocks of the map's area still not fetched; 0 unless the run stopped on a busy server

ways_stored.description: roads and water lines this run's answers carried, counting a way that crosses a block edge once per block

map_ways.description: roads and water lines the map holds after this run

stopped.description: complete: every pending block was fetched. overpass_busy: the server answered 429, 502, 503 or 504 to a block three times running, after at least one block was stored; a run that stores nothing on a busy server is the overpass_busy error instead, at exit 1
